related_questions.question: Is Japan tax refund for tourist 2025?

text_blocks.snippet: In 2025, Japan is transitioning to a new tax-free shopping system for tourists, moving from an immediate tax exemption to a refund-based system. Instead of paying tax-free prices at the point of purchase, visitors will initially pay the full price including consumption tax. Upon departure, they can then claim a refund for the tax paid, after customs confirms the items are being taken out of the country. This change is designed to prevent the resale of tax-free items within Japan.
snippet_highlighted_words: Upon departure, they can then claim a refund for the tax paid, after customs confirms the items are being taken out of the country

text_blocks.snippet: Here's a breakdown of the key changes:

list.title: Shift to a refund system:
list.snippet: Tourists will pay the full price (including consumption tax) at the time of purchase.

list.title: Departure refund:
list.snippet: Upon departure, travelers will present their purchases to customs officials and receive a refund.

list.title: No more immediate tax exemption:
list.snippet: The current system of tax-free prices at the point of purchase will be replaced by the refund process.

list.title: Potential for streamlining:
list.snippet: The distinction between general goods and consumables may be eliminated, simplifying procedures for both retailers and tourists.

list.title: Customs verification:
list.snippet: Customs will verify that the items are being taken out of the country before issuing refunds.

list.title: Potential for increased airport congestion:
list.snippet: The new system may lead to longer queues at airports due to customs checks.

text_blocks.snippet: These changes are expected to be finalized in the 2025 tax reform, with implementation planned for the 2026 fiscal year, according to Time Out Worldwide.

Japanese local governments (prefectural and municipal governments) levy local inhabitant's tax on a taxpayer's prior year income. This applies when the taxpayer is a resident of Japan as of January 1 of the current year.
